<!--
Results report of hcesfort (use_report_template()). Render the data
readiness report first: this report shows only the sections its verdict
enables. Inputs and choices live in _inputs.R, shared with readiness.qmd;
do not set them here. Edit the title above and write your own text where
the comments say; guidance for the analyst stays in comments like this one
and never reaches the output. The report states results: interpreting
them is the analyst's work.
Every exhibit is printed by show_exhibit() with the ID of exhibits.csv;
titles, notes and sentences come from terms.csv. Figures are in the body;
their tables are in the appendix, under the same ID.
Design: docs/design-reports-v3.md of the package, section 6.
-->

```{r setup}
writeLines(utils::capture.output(utils::sessionInfo()),
           "results-sessionInfo.txt")
source("_inputs.R", local = TRUE)
source("_chain.R", local = TRUE)
source("_tables.R", local = TRUE)
source("_figures.R", local = TRUE)
source("_exhibits.R", local = TRUE)
source("_results.R", local = TRUE)
source("_scenarios.R", local = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(results = "asis")
```

```{r stop-if-not-ready}
if (!ready) {
  print_sentences(fill(term("not_ready", "sentence"),
                       inputs = collapse(absent)))
  knitr::knit_exit()
}
```

## Main findings

```{r findings}
show_exhibit("R0")
```

## 1. Coverage of the vehicles


## 2. Inadequate apparent intake

```{r risk}
if (show_exhibit("R2.1")) show_domains("R2.2")
```

## 3. Fortification scenarios

```{r scenarios}
if (show_exhibit("R3.1")) {
  show_effects()
  show_exhibit("R3.3")
  show_effects(equity = TRUE)
}
```
